description.value: Chuihong is a Korean-Chinese fusion restaurant in Surrey's Fraser Heights neighbourhood, specializing in classics like Jjajangmyeon (black bean noodles), TangSooYuk (sweet-and-sour fried pork), and Jjambong (spicy seafood noodle soup). It has built a loyal local following and manages demand through a virtual waitlist system. The restaurant also offers meal kits for customers who want to recreate the dishes at home.
